title: Efficient Natural Language to Temporal Logic Translation for Real-Time Physical AI
abstract: arXiv:2611.27489v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Robots can be controlled to perform tasks with guaranteed correctness when the task instructions are stated in a formal language. Large language models (LLMs) have been widely used to allow users to provide such instructions in natural language (NL), by translating NL into formal language. When deploying such translators on a robot, however, we face limited computing and energy resources, while offloading computation or data to the cloud may be infeasible or undesirable. Yet an LLM is a general-purpose text generator, whereas a formula in a fixed formal language fragment follows a well-defined syntax. We therefore ask whether text generation is needed at all. For the formal language of linear temporal logic (LTL), we show that this translation can instead be broken down into answering a set of questions with pre-defined answers. translated_title: 面向实时物理人工智能的高效自然语言到时序逻辑翻译
translated_abstract: 当任务指令以形式化语言表述时，机器人可以被控制执行任务并保证正确性。大语言模型（LLM）已被广泛用于让用户以自然语言（NL）提供此类指令，即将自然语言翻译为形式化语言。然而，将此类翻译器部署在机器人上时，我们面临计算和能源资源有限的问题，而将计算或数据卸载到云端可能不可行或不理想。此外，大语言模型是一个通用文本生成器，而固定形式化语言片段中的公式遵循明确定义的语法。因此，我们提出疑问：是否真的需要文本生成。对于线性时序逻辑（LTL）这一形式化语言，我们证明这种翻译可以转而分解为回答一组具有预定义答案的问题。随后，我们构建了一个System-One模型——一类新兴的基于自然语言的分类器——来提供这些答案，从而实现……
tldr: 该论文提出将自然语言到线性时序逻辑的翻译分解为回答一组预定义答案的问题，用轻量级System-One分类器替代大语言模型的文本生成，从而在计算和能源资源受限的机器人上实现高效实时的翻译。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes decomposing natural language to linear temporal logic (LTL) translation into answering a set of questions with pre-defined answers, using a lightweight System-One classifier instead of LLM text generation, enabling efficient real-time translation on resource-constrained robots.
